name: Robert Hidri
title: IoT Engineer · Architect
tagline: I build connected systems — from embedded firmware on microcontrollers to cloud dashboards and everything in between.

about.heading: Bridging hardware and software
paragraphs: I'm an IoT engineer with a dual passion for embedded systems and building architecture. My background spans firmware development on ARM microcontrollers, Python backend services, and web-based dashboards for real-time data.
During my internship at Genelec OY in Iisalmi, Finland, I worked on production-related technology systems, gaining hands-on experience with industrial processes and audio engineering excellence.

I approach every project with an architect's mindset — whether I'm designing a sensor network or a software system, I think about structure, modularity, and how the pieces connect. This portfolio itself is built on a plugin architecture where each module is a self-contained unit that plugs into the dashboard.

experience.description: Genelec is a world-leading manufacturer of professional active loudspeakers. During my 10-month internship I worked with production technology and gained exposure to industrial IoT systems, quality-driven engineering processes, and cross-functional collaboration in a manufacturing environment.

Building a personal ecosystem of connected tools: this modular portfolio platform, IoT sensor networks with ESP32 devices, Python backend services, and exploring the intersection of building architecture and smart home technology.
